title: feat(fill2site): 64 maps fill from a 2-site face-diagonal seed
science: Census plus an exact STRUCTURE theorem, not a probe cell. From the face-diagonal 2-site seed {(0,0,0),(1,1,0)}, N_fill_2=64 of the 512 vanish-on-empty cube-covariant maps fill - and the filler set is characterized exactly, not just counted: a map fills iff f=0 on empty and f=1 on the three orbits (1,0,2), (2,0,1), (3,0,0) (the axis-types with no doubly occupied axis), leaving the other six orbit bits free, hence 2^6=64. The runner verifies set equality with that predicted class, not merely the cardinality. f_L1 fills at T=3 with history (2,7,11,12); f_two (u>=2) halts at 4 locks; f_any (any nonempty tuple) fills with the identical history. This subcube characterization is stronger than the bare N_fill=96 of the 1-site census #6393.
